title: Belfast, Northern Ireland — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Belfast, Northern Ireland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Belfast is a city in Northern Ireland with a population of 345,418. Northern Ireland’s capital with a transformed city center, thriving film industry, and the UK’s lowest cost of living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 128 sunny days a year.
